# Sela Reader 1.3

Two products: Reader is a private installable web app on desktop, tablet and phone. Viewer is a lightweight CDN/ESM plugin for websites/frameworks, inline or fullscreen. Browser-extension distribution is discontinued.

Reader has Home, Shelf, Explore and Settings; local IndexedDB books, collections, favorites, sorting, format/status filters, grid/list views and full ZIP backup. Bottom navigation on phones, side rail on wide screens. Theme/language in Settings. Cloud backup is manual export/share/upload and restore; no automatic account sync. Sample books are saved explicitly; originals should be retained because browser storage can be evicted.

PDF (lazy PDF.js), EPUB, CBZ, TXT/MD/sanitized HTML/text FB2. Optional external GPL DjVu decoder; CBR/MOBI/AZW/DOCX/DRM unsupported. Search, embedded outlines, browser TTS, notes, filters/brightness/dim; no PDF aligned text layer, EPUB CFI or OCR. Browser/OS voices vary; no voice-service key required.

Main Viewer interface ~26.6 KiB gzip, excluding decoder, document and optional modules. No Bootstrap/jQuery or UI framework dependency. Web app installation depends on browser capabilities. Old browsers receive original PDF links; iPhone 4 cannot run the full offline app. Physical device validation remains outstanding.

Web app: https://bobbyfch.github.io/sela/mobile/
Products: https://github.com/bobbyfch/sela/blob/main/docs/products.md
App installation: https://github.com/bobbyfch/sela/blob/main/docs/pwa.md
Viewer installation: https://github.com/bobbyfch/sela/blob/main/docs/install.md
Pinned CDN: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bobbyfch/sela@v1.3.2/dist/js/sela.min.js
FlippyPDF main preserves v1.0.0 assets and directs new users to Sela. Historical CDN caches cannot be recalled.
